scenarios.title: Instant typing
scenarios.description: keyboard.type(text) with no delay: the most common way to automate a form.

expectation.statement: Keys arrive about a millisecond apart and are held for under a millisecond. PASS needs the 95% lower bound of the flagged rate to reach 90%.

scenarios.title: Fixed-delay typing
scenarios.description: keyboard.type(text, delay=120): the 'slow it down' option of the same call.

expectation.statement: Every key is held exactly as long as the delay and keys follow one another instantly. PASS needs the 95% lower bound of the flagged rate to reach 90%.

scenarios.title: Metronome script
scenarios.description: Key down, wait 60 ms, key up, wait 110 ms, repeat.

expectation.statement: Identical hold and gap on every key. PASS needs the 95% lower bound of the flagged rate to reach 90%.

scenarios.title: Burst injection
scenarios.description: Chunks of 5-14 characters typed instantly, 0.4-0.85 s apart.

expectation.statement: Rapid clusters separated by fixed gaps. PASS needs the 95% lower bound of the flagged rate to reach 90%.

scenarios.title: Random-delay bot
scenarios.description: Independent random hold (45-140 ms) and gap (70-260 ms) per key, 3% longer pauses.

expectation.statement: The standard evasion. No target is set: detection is expected to grow with session length (the synthetic benchmark shows 13% at 10-19 keys up to 98% at 200+).

scenarios.title: Human-statistics mimic
scenarios.description: Copies a typical human's mean and spread with bell-shaped noise, plus pauses.

expectation.statement: The hard case. Partial detection is the documented outcome (the synthetic benchmark shows 45%).

scenarios.title: Programmatic fill (no keystrokes)
scenarios.description: page.fill(): sets the field values with no key events at all.

expectation.statement: With no keystrokes there is nothing to score. Agent 4 correctly returns no verdict, so the platform has to treat 'bid submitted with no behavioural data' as a signal of its own.

scenarios.detail: 40/40 bids had no behavioural data and Agent 4 gave no verdict

scenarios.title: Replay of a recorded person
scenarios.description: Replays the exact keystroke timing a real person produced on the portal.

expectation.statement: A replay of genuine human timing is genuine human timing. A timing-only detector cannot catch it (documented limitation); most should pass as human.

scenarios.detail: No sessions recorded for this scenario yet.

scenarios.title: Simulated typical human
scenarios.tool: Simulated human (training-data generator) replayed in Edge
scenarios.description: Timing from the training generator's typical-human profile.

expectation.statement: False-alarm rate consistent with the 5% design target: PASS needs the 95% upper bound of the flagged rate to be at most 15%; FAIL if its lower bound is above 10%.

scenarios.detail: 5/60 flagged (8%, 95% CI 4-18%); not enough visits to show 15% or less
